name: std::make_error_code(std::errc)
intro:
Creates error code value for errc enum e.

Equivalent to std::error_code(static_cast<int>(e), std::generic_category())

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
e

 -

 error code enum to create error code for

examples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.
